Key asks in this message:

- Let us know if you need us to run the smoke tests against your sandbox region (we can schedule a dedicated run and hand over logs).

Attached: pilot-smoke-tests-v1.xlsx (test cases & pass/fail rules), mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf (timelines + responsibilities).

Alex / Leah —

Appreciate the quick review. Two points to keep the acceptance criteria unambiguous:

1) Acceptance heuristics: we will categorize each smoke-test case as Pass / Conditional-Pass / Blocker. Conditional-Pass cases require remediation before GA but allow pilot to continue while tracking mitigations. Blockers must be fixed before we hand over to production staging.

2) Variant thresholds: we will add a column in the ledger for "Sandbox Threshold" vs "Preprod Threshold". Default strategy: sandbox = +50ms tolerance; preprod = production target. We will call out any test where the tolerance cannot be relaxed.

Operational notes:
- Redwood will provide the raw token-level logs and a prebuilt dashboard in the Console for the smoke-run.
- Suggested timeline (draft):
  * Week 0: MAP signoff and account provisioning
  * Week 1: Smoke-run 1 (functional flows)
  * Week 2: SOC/security evidence review and remediation
  * Week 3: Smoke-run 2 (latency/cost stability)
  * Week 4: Final stakeholder review and close decision

Can Marissa pick up the task of documenting the signoff matrix and adding the DocuSign links? Ben, flag if there are any pricing concessions to mention before signoff.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
